rejections: Do not display KAI's prompt, product brief, audience brief, or creative instructions.

Do not repeat generic creator-at-a-desk footage or unrelated phone footage.
Do not reuse fixed headlines or the same campaign music.

Use a believable human voice as the main storytelling layer.
Show the actual product mechanism and buyer outcome, not generic motivation.
Keep visible captions short and subordinate to the spoken story.
